description.zh: 查询批量授权设备进度的唯一ID。
description.en: The unique ID for querying the progress of batch device authorization.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 对于新版公共实例或企业版实例，实例有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 对于旧版公共实例，实例无ID值，无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- For a new public instance or an Enterprise instance, the instance has an ID value, which must be provided. Otherwise, the API invocation will fail.
- For a legacy public instance, the instance does not have an ID value, so it is not required.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。
description.en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P**, **720P**.

description.zh:
设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

You can view information about all products under the current instance either in the IoT Platform console or by invoking the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) API.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
已调用[BindLicenseDevice](~~427961~~)接口为设备授权License，获取返回的查询授权进度的**CheckProgressId**。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
You have already called the [BindLicenseDevice](~~427961~~) API to authorize a license for devices and obtained the **CheckProgressId** for querying the authorization progress.

## Queries per second (QPS) limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot check-bind-license-device-progress --iot-instance-id iot-2ws0000 --license-code 720P --product-key uhf50000 --check-progress-id 230000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
